# Real tool outputs, for the Content gate's tests

What HipSTR (b2033bf) and GangSTR (v2.5) wrote for the public GIAB NA12878
autosomal slice (`illumina_slices/NA12878.autosomal.bam`) with the regions
library files, run locally with the committed recipes. Public reference sample,
24 forensic loci; kept so `content_auto` is tested against the real shape of
each tool's VCF, not a synthetic one.
